downstreamRouting.championLayer: Flo reads this for proposal body — challenge description, Stage 1-2-3 bullets, team benefit language. Maria is the internal champion: she needs to see Crystal and Holly's pain named exactly, with concrete 'things that stop happening' outcomes.
downstreamRouting.economicBuyerLayer: Rex reads this for executive summary, ROI section, FOMO entries, and closing. Linda signs the contract: she needs a payback period, a cost anchor, and a peer comparison — not operational detail.

champion.challengeFraming: Name the exact manual process and the role of the person doing it. Use the specific words from their transcript. 'Your {job title} manually {exact process} every {frequency} — that stops on go-live day.' If they said it, use their exact phrasing.
champion.fomoFraming: Lead with hours saved and the specific manual task that disappears. Structure: '{X hours/week} recovered — {the exact task} is gone on go-live day.' No AI framing needed for the hook — Stage 1 outcomes carry the pitch.
champion.journeyFraming: Stage 1 bullet items should read like a 'things that stop happening Monday morning' list. Use active verbs: 'stops,' 'disappears,' 'no longer.' Stage 2 gets two sentences. Stage 3 gets one — plant the seed without over-pitching to someone who wants immediate relief.
champion.closingLineVariant: Stage 1 eliminates the specific manual work your team does today. Stages 2 and 3 build on that foundation — but the immediate win is on go-live day.

economicBuyer.executiveSummaryFraming: Open with a payback period and a cost anchor — convert Crystal's manual invoicing hours to an annual dollar figure before naming any system or process. Linda reads the executive summary: lead with 'the cost of staying manual vs. the monthly service rate' before any operational detail.
economicBuyer.challengeFraming: Open with a cost or time figure from their transcript — even an estimate. If they said 'we spend hours on this,' convert to weekly/annual cost. Anchor the challenge in a number they recognized when they said it.
economicBuyer.fomoFraming: Lead with the dollar amount or hours recovered. Name the number before naming the company. Structure: '{$X saved} by connecting {systems} — here is how.'
economicBuyer.closingLineVariant: The managed service model turns the ROI calculation into a single line: the cost of staying manual vs. the monthly service rate.
